An edible pepper found in the [[borderlands]]. {{Ref|{{twotc}}}}

One of [[Siuan Sanche|Siuan]]‘s little sayings is, “if you want to keep something hidden...don’t try to buy coin peppers this far south.” Alluding to the fact that since they are popular (and likely produced) in the [[Shienar]] and [[Malkier]], then finding some in [[Ebou Dar]] may point towards a less than reputable merchant. {{Ref/book|7|12}}
